title: Constitutional Bodies of Nepal
description: Quiz on roles, independence, and oversight of constitutional commissions.

questions.question: Key feature of constitutional commissions:
questions.explanation: Independence supports credibility and mandate delivery.

questions.question: True or False: Overlapping mandates can reduce effectiveness.
Select accountability mechanisms.
questions.explanation: Reporting, hearings, and review enhance accountability.

questions.question: Risk sign for politicization:
questions.explanation: Dominant partisan appointments may erode neutrality.

questions.question: Performance indicator for oversight body:
questions.explanation: Implementation rate shows effectiveness of recommendations.
